profile.languages: Arabic (official), Tamazight languages (Tamazight (official), Tachelhit, Tarifit), French (often the language of business, government, and diplomacy)
profile.religions: Muslim 99% (official; virtually all Sunni, <0.1% Shia), other 1% (includes Christian, Jewish, and Baha'i); note - Jewish about 3,000-3,500 (2020 est.)
profile.legalSystem: mixed system of civil law based on French civil law and Islamic (sharia) law; Constitutional Court reviews legislative acts
profile.nationalHoliday: Throne Day (accession of King MOHAMMED VI to the throne), 30 July (1999)
profile.location: Northern Africa, bordering the North Atlantic Ocean and the Mediterranean Sea, between Algeria and Mauritania
